video_title: Hugo Gonzalez NOT Focused on Individual Goals | Celtics vs Hawks Pregame

quotes.speaker: Hugo Gonzalez
quotes.summary_phrase: Hugo Gonzalez emphasizes collective team goals over individual performance
quotes.excerpt: My goal, I've never been individual. I would say our goal is collective.
quotes.quote: My goal, I've never been individual. I would say our goal is collective. Obviously we have had some rough streaks in the West. We have four games in a row, but that also helps us to be who we want to be. For you to win, you have to know how many hurts you to lose. I think we've been on a four-game streak of losing, we don't like to lose, we don't like this feeling. We have to get out of it as soon as possible. That made us, obviously you don't want to lose games, that made us build something better for the future.
quotes.social_post: Hugo Gonzalez says his focus remains on collective team goals rather than individual stats as the Celtics look to bounce back from a four game losing streak

structured.context: Hugo Gonzalez discusses the team's collective goals and their recent four-game losing streak during a pregame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Hugo Gonzalez
quotes.summary_phrase: Hugo Gonzalez on the depth and competitive culture of the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: We have a lot of wings and a lot of players that can impact.
quotes.quote: We have a lot of wings and a lot of players that can impact, and they show they can impact Jordan, Baylor, Sam, Ron, me. Obviously it's we have to fight for the minutes, but also we have to encourage each other to be better. At the end of the day, that's what's going to make us be better as a team, so we have to keep doing that.
quotes.social_post: Hugo Gonzalez on the Celtics rotation battle: We have a lot of wings who can impact the game and we have to fight for minutes while encouraging each other to be better

structured.context: Hugo Gonzalez talks about the team's depth and the competitive nature of the roster during a pregame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Hugo Gonzalez
quotes.summary_phrase: Hugo Gonzalez defines team culture as healthy competition for minutes
quotes.excerpt: I define that as a healthy competition. Obviously everybody is competitive against each other.
quotes.quote: I define that as a healthy competition. Obviously everybody is competitive against each other and against the other team especially. Everybody wants to play and everybody wants to take advantage of the opportunity. I think that's what makes us play like if our life was on the line sometimes. That a lot of times benefits the team, so I just think that it's a healthy competition against each other, but mainly against the other teams.
quotes.social_post: Hugo Gonzalez describes the Celtics internal culture as healthy competition: Everybody wants to play and take advantage of the opportunity and that makes us play like our life is on the line

structured.context: Hugo Gonzalez describes the internal competition for playing time within the Celtics roster during a pregame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Hugo Gonzalez
quotes.summary_phrase: Hugo Gonzalez on the team's response to a four-game losing streak
quotes.excerpt: You have to lose to learn how much you want to win.
quotes.quote: Anybody wants to lose, and especially here you don't want to lose, especially four in a row. It was tough, but you have to lose. Like I said before, you have to lose to learn how much you want to win. Now we know that we want to win a lot more than what we thought. Maybe at the beginning of the season we were 11-2, we got a little reality shock of, shit, we have to earn every single win every single night. I think that's just going to help us for playing to win even more than we did in the first four games.
quotes.social_post: Hugo Gonzalez says the recent four game losing streak served as a reality check for the Celtics: We have to earn every single win every single night

structured.context: Hugo Gonzalez reflects on the team's early season success and the lessons learned from their recent losing streak.
